messages:
Emily (PM): Posted the PRD draft for customer-driven scope. Need quick callouts so we can lock scope by EOD. Two concrete decisions: tenant pinning for top customers vs 10% A/B split, and precise canary acceptance/rollback criteria. Also need edge-case list (tenant cache isolation, key management, sample capture).

Raj (Eng): Leaning toward tenant pin for top-2 paying customers (SLA constraints). A/B for the rest. Pinning adds routing + per-tenant cache keys work. Rough estimate: 1.5w to get minimal routing + pin metadata.

Priya (SRE): +1 on pin for paying customers. Rollback guardrails are critical: auto-failover to v1 if error_rate > 1% over a 5m window OR token cost >2x baseline for 10m. Require on-call coverage first 72h of rollout.

Mateo (ML): For quality, add human-in-the-loop sampling when eval signals drop. Suggest auto-alert at 3% relative drop on high-signal eval set and require HIL review at 3-5%. Auto-rollback threshold at >=5%. Also capture 1% of example requests (PII scrubbed) for postmortem.

Emily (PM): Consolidating proposed acceptance criteria:
- Tenant strategy: pin top-2 customers to v2 for first launch; 10% A/B for other eligible tenants in region-US.
- Canary acceptance: error_rate <= 0.5% AND p95 latency <= 1.2x baseline AND eval_drop < 3% (auto-alert).
- Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% for 5m OR eval_drop >= 5% OR cost > 2x baseline for 10m.
- Safety: HIL sample capture (1% requests, PII scrub), KMS-backed logs, on-call rota for 72h.

Also calling out edge cases: pinned tenant loses pin when model removed; need explicit pin expiration TTL and audit logs. Must support per-tenant rate limits when pinned.

Raj (Eng): I'll add engineering checklist to PRD: routing changes, pin metadata + UI, cache isolation + keying, telemetry dashboards, rollout orchestration job. Minimal shippable scope (MVP) goal: 2 weeks for core routing + metrics, +1 week for UI + audit.

Priya (SRE): I'll draft runbook and on-call schedule. Need a safe rollback playbook with automated routing flip and notification steps.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: Created canary window 2026-04-05T10:00Z -> 2026-04-07T10:00Z; notifier: #oncall; runbook link: https://deploys/redwood/1953334444

Emily (PM): :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll update PRD with the acceptance checklist and edge-case table. If no objections by 17:00 PT today, we'll lock scope and create the JIRA epic.

Raj (Eng): No objections from eng side, filing epic now.

Mateo (ML): Added eval dashboard queries to the doc.

Priya (SRE): Will add runbook PR before EOD.

Emily (PM): Great — sync 1pm if anyone wants to walk the rollout steps. Otherwise I'll post final PRD when locked.
